reviews.title: Good case
reviews.comment: Great case for my first build I looked up the company they're a California based company so took a shot and I'm satisfied so far the only thing where the graphics card screws on to the back of the case I couldn't find the screws to fit so I used a zip tie to secure it into place
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.title: Great air flow and temps for a smaller case, fans i would replace
reviews.comment: i have this case with a tuf gaming x870 mobo, 9850x3d cpu with a peerless assassin air cooler with arctic mx-6 tp, and a pny rtx 5070 ti gpu. I replaced the molex non adjustable fans that came with the case with some matching thermalright 120mm argb fans and it works great with the airflow. I get 39 degree idle cpu power package, between 50-60 degrees gaming and 71 degrees all core testing on cinebench, again this was the hot spot on my cpu, not the cpu sensor which is 10-11 degrees cooler. i"ve had the case for almost a year now, switched out my motherboard a couple times and its holding up great. i would recommend if you have limited space.
reviews.author: Adam White

reviews.title: I'm starting to think I'm a SuperMom
reviews.comment: K.  So I decided I was gonna build my new pc and give my child my old one.  I'll spare you all the details of what I went thru.  But when it came to a case I wanted something that allowed air flow and had fans.  There were some other options but I liked this one for the glass side, the mesh, and the colours.  Well.  Installing the motherboard and other components was relatively easy.  I had lots of space to work with and any problems I had were of my own making (for instance lining up the slots in the back with the cards I was installing).  I wasn't sure if I liked how the fans hooked to one another but in the end all of that was hidden. When I finally got to turn it on, I had a Frankenstein moment (ITS ALIVE!!!) and it was beautiful.  BEST PART, it was whisper quiet. All those fans, plus the one on my chip, and I barely hear anything.  My son is so jealous. And every time I turn it on there's a knowing smile of "I did that".  Now need to rearrange my den cause its too pretty to put under a desk.  If I was looking to build a pc again, I would get this case...again.
reviews.author: DS

reviews.title: 6 MONTHS AFTER PURCHASE REVIEW
reviews.comment:
I ordered this in early January and now it's June and all I have to say about the product is good things.
- It looks amazing
- The 6 FANS are RGB are connected together and most PCs should be compatible with it. I'm still wondering if there is a way to change color but they were super easy to connect to my power supply unit.
- I did have a problem when I first order the product. The glass panel broke through the shipping. However, I got in contact quickly and the support team was quick and friendly to get the issue solved. They sent me a new one for free which was a relief for me.
Overall I give this product a 9/10. Thank You!
reviews.author: Gavin

reviews.title: Came damaged
reviews.comment: Unable to contact. All links to supplier are not accessible and when I call the number provided there is no answer. The mesh on top is held on by a magnet and slides around easily. I purchased two of these the other one is fine and looks good and doing the build this week will update ease of build after complete. I was able to bend the panel to fit in place but motherboard supporting wall is warped.
